mapper.select: SELECT b.branch_code AS branchCode, b.name AS branchName, b.address, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, b.lat, b.lng, (6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{currentLat})) * COS(RADIANS(b.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b.lng) - RADIANS(#{currentLng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{currentLat})) * SIN(RADIANS(b.lat)) )) AS distance FROM branch b JOIN branch_stock bs ON b.branch_code = bs.branch_code WHERE b.branch_code != #{currentBranchCode} AND b.branch_code != 1 AND bs.material_code = #{materialCode} AND bs.current_qty >= #{requiredQty} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' HAVING distance <= #{distance} ORDER BY distance;
SELECT lat, lng FROM branch WHERE branch_code = #{branchCode}
SELECT material_group_id as materialGroupId, group_name as groupName FROM material_group ORDER BY material_group_id;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_swap (req_branch_code, res_branch_code, material_code, qty, status) VALUES (#{reqBranchCode}, #{resBranchCode}, #{materialCode}, #{qty}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT ms.swap_id AS swapId, ms.req_branch_code AS reqBranchCode, b1.name AS reqBranchName, ms.res_branch_code AS resBranchCode, b2.name AS resBranchName, ms.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, ms.qty, ms.status, DATE_FORMAT(ms.req_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reqDate, b2.address, (6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(b1.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b2.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b2.lng) - RADIANS(b1.lng)) + SIN(RADIANS(b1.lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(b2.lat)) )) AS distance FROM material_swap ms JOIN branch b1 ON ms.req_branch_code = b1.branch_code JOIN branch b2 ON ms.res_branch_code = b2.branch_code JOIN material m ON ms.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ms.req_branch_code = #{branchCode} AND b2.branch_code != 1 ORDER BY ms.req_date DESC

SELECT ms.swap_id AS swapId, ms.req_branch_code AS reqBranchCode, b1.name AS reqBranchName, ms.res_branch_code AS resBranchCode, b2.name AS resBranchName, ms.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, ms.qty, ms.status, DATE_FORMAT(ms.req_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reqDate, b1.address, (6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(b2.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b1.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b1.lng) - RADIANS(b2.lng)) + SIN(RADIANS(b2.lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(b1.lat)) )) AS distance FROM material_swap ms JOIN branch b1 ON ms.req_branch_code = b1.branch_code JOIN branch b2 ON ms.res_branch_code = b2.branch_code JOIN material m ON ms.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ms.res_branch_code = #{branchCode} AND ms.status = 'PENDING' AND b1.branch_code != 1 ORDER BY ms.req_date DESC

SELECT ms.swap_id AS swapId, ms.req_branch_code AS reqBranchCode, b1.name AS reqBranchName, ms.res_branch_code AS resBranchCode, b2.name AS resBranchName, ms.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, ms.qty, ms.status, DATE_FORMAT(ms.req_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reqDate, CASE WHEN ms.req_branch_code = #{branchCode} THEN b2.address ELSE b1.address END AS address, 0 AS distance FROM material_swap ms JOIN branch b1 ON ms.req_branch_code = b1.branch_code JOIN branch b2 ON ms.res_branch_code = b2.branch_code JOIN material m ON ms.material_code = m.material_code WHERE (ms.req_branch_code = #{branchCode} OR ms.res_branch_code = #{branchCode}) AND ms.status = 'COMPLETED' AND b1.branch_code != 1 AND b2.branch_code != 1 ORDER BY ms.req_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE material_swap SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE swap_id = #{swapId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branch_stock_change_history (branch_stock_code, change_amount, change_type, after_qty, changed_at) VALUES (#{branchStockCode}, #{changeAmount}, #{changeType}, #{afterQty}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT swap_id AS swapId, req_branch_code AS reqBranchCode, res_branch_code AS resBranchCode, material_code AS materialCode, qty, status FROM material_swap WHERE swap_id = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_swap SET status = 'REJECTED' WHERE swap_id = #{value} AND status = 'PENDING'
DELETE FROM material_swap WHERE swap_id = #{value} AND status = 'PENDING'
